description: Logging improvement for the Python nightly ETL pipeline owned by the data engineering team. The customer-orders batch job (etl_pipeline.py) prints every row at every stage, dumps entire record payloads to stdout, and failed rows vanish without a trace, making nightly incidents impossible to diagnose. Bring its logging up to production batch standard. Do not change the transformation logic. Confine the change to etl_pipeline.py — do not create new files, documentation, or tests.
